description: Coverage Countdown (patient view, MassHealth, H2). A new CoverageTab in the patient phone lets the user enter/edit their next MassHealth renewal date (demo default ~21 days out for Maria), shows a live day countdown, 30/14/7-day reminder markers with TEXT labels, a plain-language 'what to expect' explainer, a note about 6-month renewals starting 2027, and an external link to mass.gov/masshealth. The renewal date is stored CLIENT-SIDE ONLY in localStorage (decisions #11/#16) — no backend, no network, no services/api.js change. Must include the exact eligibility-disclaimer line and must NOT ask for a MassHealth ID number. Depends on FEAT-001 only because FEAT-001 adds the tab bar to PatientPortal.jsx; this feature adds the Coverage tab button and render branch to that same bar.
steps: Create frontend/src/components/CoverageTab.jsx. State: renewalDate string (YYYY-MM-DD). On mount, read from localStorage key 'relay.coverage.renewalDate'; if absent, default to today + 21 days (compute) and persist it. A controlled <input type="date"> with an associated <label> lets the user edit the date; on change, update state AND write to localStorage. Do NOT send the date anywhere (no fetch, no api.js import).

Render a live countdown of whole days remaining until the renewal date. Use useNow() from ../hooks for a ticking re-render; compute daysRemaining from the stored date. Announce the countdown as text (e.g. 'Renewal in 21 days') so it does not rely on color; include an aria-live region or clear text label for screen readers.

Render reminder markers for 30, 14, and 7 days before the renewal date, each with a TEXT label (e.g. '30-day reminder: reached' / 'not yet') — never color alone. These are in-app visual indicators only; NO SMS and no scheduling of texts (decision #19).

Add a plain-language 'What to expect' explainer for MassHealth renewal (describe/route only, never interpret or decide), a sentence that some members will need to renew every 6 months starting in 2027, and an external link `<a href="https://www.mass.gov/masshealth" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">` (link out, do not copy official text).

Include the EXACT line `MassHealth decides eligibility. This is a reminder, not a decision.` verbatim and visible. Include NO field, input, or prompt for a MassHealth ID number anywhere in the component. Label Maria as 'Fictional demo persona' on screen.

Ensure WCAG 2.1 AA: label the date input (htmlFor/id via useId like LoginScreen.jsx), large readable text, high-contrast tokens (--text on --card), keyboard operable, focus-visible, and text labels for every reminder state (not color alone).

Edit frontend/src/screens/PatientPortal.jsx (additive, building on FEAT-001's tab bar): add `import CoverageTab from '../components/CoverageTab'`; add a 'Coverage' button to the existing `<div className="tabs" role="tablist">`; add `{tab === 'coverage' && <CoverageTab />}`. Do not change offer/socket logic or FEAT-001's branches.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` (from frontend/) succeeds with CoverageTab wired into PatientPortal.jsx.
The renewal date persists across reloads via localStorage and is NEVER sent to the backend (no network request, no services/api.js change for coverage); the backend has no table or endpoint for it.

The UI shows a live day countdown, 30/14/7-day reminders with TEXT labels, a plain-language explainer, the 2027 6-month note, an external mass.gov/masshealth link opening in a new tab with rel noopener, and the exact line "MassHealth decides eligibility. This is a reminder, not a decision." verbatim.
There is NO MassHealth ID number field anywhere in the component.
The date input is labeled, the countdown is screen-reader friendly, reminders do not rely on color alone, and the UI is keyboard operable with large text (WCAG 2.1 AA).
verification: From frontend/: `npm run build` — build succeeds, no errors.

Grep-free manual check during the convergence step: load #patient, open the Coverage tab, confirm the date edits and persists across reload, the countdown ticks, reminders show text labels, the exact disclaimer line is present, there is no ID field, and the mass.gov link opens in a new tab. (Backend pytest from FEAT-001 must still pass unchanged — coverage adds no backend code.)
findings: Implemented CoverageTab. Created frontend/src/components/CoverageTab.jsx (client-side only: renewal date read/written to localStorage key 'relay.coverage.renewalDate', defaults to today+21 days; NO api.js import, no fetch, no backend). Wired into frontend/src/screens/PatientPortal.jsx additively on FEAT-001's tab bar: added import, a 'Coverage' tablist button, and a `{tab === 'coverage' && <CoverageTab />}` branch; offer/socket/standby/emergency logic untouched. Added additive .coverage-* rules to styles.css reusing existing :root tokens. UI includes: live day countdown via useNow() announced as text in an aria-live='polite' status region (not color); 30/14/7-day reminder markers each with TEXT labels ('N-day reminder: reached'/'not yet') plus a color accent on top (text is authoritative); plain-language 'What to expect' explainer (describe/route only, no eligibility interpretation); the 2027 6-month renewal note; external link to https://www.mass.gov/masshealth with target=_blank and rel='noopener noreferrer'; a 'no texts / in-app only' note (decision #19); the exact verbatim line 'MassHealth decides eligibility. This is a reminder, not a decision.'; Maria labeled 'Fictional demo persona'. NO MassHealth ID field anywhere (decision #20). A11y: date input labeled via useId htmlFor/id with aria-describedby hint, min-height 44px targets, focus-visible outlines, large readable text on --card/--text tokens, keyboard operable. VERIFICATION: frontend `npm run build` succeeded (27 modules, built in ~171ms, no errors). Backend pytest unchanged: 13 passed, 1 warning, exit 0 (coverage adds no backend code). No vitals/doctor/charts/PDF files touched. NOTE: terminal harness returned a spurious exit code -1 and garbled command echo for every command, but captured stdout confirmed both the successful Vite build and the 13-passing pytest run (output was redirected to a temp file, read, then the temp file removed).
